content:
I’m pleased to announce the next major release of Aurora. The two main themes of this release are:

  • Expanding on the foundational work of the previous releases around color tokens, painters and shapers
  • The introduction of a brand new skin, Blueprint (image above)

Among the many other new features and bug fixes in this release:

  • Introduction of component shapers that replace the previously available button shapers and expand the scope to all components
  • Revisited API surface of decoration painters, folding the overlay painters to be managed by decoration painters, and introducing the brand new inlay painters
  • Unified visuals of tab buttons and newly added tab decorators that allow custom visuals of tabs
  • New color tokens for marker-on-container and container-shadow
  • New window decorators
  • Alphas for color tokens under enabled states
  • Additional customization options for title panes for button icons and title texts
  • Improve contrast and fidelity of icon filtering

Aurora focuses on helping you make elegant and high-performing desktop applications in Compose. If you’re in the business of writing just such apps, I’d love for you to take this Aurora release for a spin.
